description: Sanitizes all string values in a string, array, object, or record
label: Sanitize Value

options.label: Value
options.name: value
options.info: The value to sanitize. Accepts a plain string, array, object, or record. All string values within the structure are Unicode-normalized (NFKC) and stripped of emojis, backticks, and any characters outside of letters, numbers, punctuation, whitespace, and line breaks.

options.name: schema
options.label: Schema
options.info: Optional schema model to map the sanitized output to. When provided, the result is cast to the selected model's shape.

options.name: result
options.label: Result as
options.info: Variable name to store the sanitized output in. The output type matches the input: a sanitized string, array, or an object shaped by the selected schema model.
